description: Baseline weighted aggregation for the DID whose raw inputs appear in §7.3.4. Dimension scores are the published integers derived from those inputs. Sum(wi x di) = 25*100 + 25*99 + 20*80 + 20*82 + 10*74 = 8955, divided by 100 gives 89.55; the DID is mature (m = 1), out of probation and free of anomalies, so half-up rounding yields 90. Aggregating from the PUBLISHED integers rather than the unrounded ratios is what makes this reproducible by a verifier reading §7.3.3 metadata.
